answer: Agents forecasting the horizon or planning a summit route could earn only after solving a fresh hash puzzle bound to their key and epoch. A public vault records used proofs; validators check the hash target and reject reuse or a proof for another key. Every added earner needs independent computation and electricity, even on parallel machines. Difficulty must make that cost exceed the extra identity reward. This assumes unpredictable challenges and sound hashes; efficient farms retain an advantage, and newcomers need compute.
